# Kenney Input Prompts (controller outlines)

Four whole-controller icons from Kenney's [Input Prompts](https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts) 1.5A (CC0, see
`License.txt`), unchanged: `controller_xboxseries.svg`, `controller_playstation5.svg`, `controller_steamdeck.svg` and
`controller_steam.svg` (the original Steam Controller). `regs-tool padglyphs` (`src/tools/pad_glyphs.cpp`) draws them
at full size as the controller pictures of the controls page (docs/controller.md), the buttons in their cut-outs.
Downloaded 2026-11-23 at the owner's request ("accurate controller silhouettes ... CC0").
